name: watersplash-clippath
title: Water Splash Clip Path
blurb: Water splash shapes clip images with organic, wavy edges.
description: Applies SVG clipPath definitions to create organic water splash silhouettes around images. Effects scale on hover.
use_when: Breaking up rigid rectangular image grids with natural, playful shapes.
avoid_when: Fine typography or small details inside clipped regions—masks can blur text.
a11y: Images must have alt text; clipPath is purely visual and transparent to screen readers.
